full_name: Philippe Grandrieux | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2015–2016 Arts Radcliffe-Harvard Film Study Center Fellow/David and Roberta Logie Fellow Independent Filmmaker (France)
bio: Philippe Grandrieux’s work covers several areas of kinetic visual arts: feature film, experimental television, video art, documentary, and museum and gallery installation.
